text: Namaste, aaj hum ek minute mein samjhenge ki API kya hoti hai? API ka full form hai, Application Programming Interface. Ise samajhne ke liye ek restaurant ka example lete hain. Maan lijiye aap ek restaurant mein table par baithe hain aur kitchen mein khana ban raha hai. Aap seedhe kitchen mein jaakar chef ko order nahi dete, balki ek waiter aata hai, aapka order leta hai, kitchen mein chef ko batata hai, aur phir khana banne ke baad aapki table par laakar deta hai. Technology ki duniya mein, API bilkul isi waiter ki tarah kaam karti hai. Jab aap apne phone par koi food delivery app ya weather app kholte hain, to aapka phone server ko ek request bhejta hai. API aapki is request ko server tak lejaati hai, wahan se zaroori data uthati hai, aur aapki screen par dikhati hai. Aasaan shabdon mein kahein to, API do alag alag software ya apps ke beech ek bridge, yaani pul ka kaam karti hai, jis se woh aapas mein baat kar paate hain, aur data share kar paate hain.
